strings.zh: 老师的教案：
strings.en: Teacher’s lesson plan:

strings.zh: 呀,您是……{SCROLL}您是冠军大人{VAR:0103:0}吧！{NEWLINE}没想到您会到我们训练家学校来。{CLEAR}如果学生知道您来了,{CLEAR}一定会非常高兴的。{SCROLL}不知道您现在是否有时间,{NEWLINE}与我们的学生交流分享下{CLEAR}您作为训练家的经验呢？
strings.en: Oh, you’re...{SCROLL}You’re Champion {VAR:0103:0}, aren’t{NEWLINE}you? I never thought you’d visit{CLEAR}our Pokémon Academy! The students{CLEAR}will be thrilled to hear you’re here.{SCROLL}If you have time now, would you{NEWLINE}share some of your experience{CLEAR}as a Trainer with our students?

strings.zh: 是因为您太忙吗……
strings.en: Is it because you’re too busy...

strings.zh: 太好了！请您随我站到讲台前面,{NEWLINE}我现在就向学生介绍您。
strings.en: Wonderful! Please follow me to the{NEWLINE}front of the class. I’ll introduce{CLEAR}you to the students right away.

strings.zh: 同学们,都安静一下。
strings.en: Class, settle down, please.

strings.zh: 我旁边站着的这位训练家,{NEWLINE}是非常了不起的人物哦。{CLEAR}你们知道是谁吗？
strings.en: The Trainer standing next{NEWLINE}to me is a very remarkable{CLEAR}person. Do you know who it is?

strings.zh: 哎？是很厉害的人吗？
strings.en: Huh? Someone really strong?

strings.zh: 会比联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}更厉害吗？
strings.en: Stronger than League{NEWLINE}Champion {VAR:0103:0}?

strings.zh: 我还是觉得小绿更厉害！
strings.en: I still think Blue’s stronger!

strings.zh: 咳！咳！大家安静！{NEWLINE}同学们可能还没认出来,{CLEAR}这位就是咱们的{CLEAR}现任联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！
strings.en: Ahem! Ahem! Quiet, everyone!{NEWLINE}You may not have recognized this{CLEAR}person, but this is our current{CLEAR}League Champion, {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: 哇！好像真的是哎！
strings.en: Wow! It really is!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}哥哥！请给我签名！
strings.en: Big Bro {VAR:0103:0}! Can I have your{NEWLINE}autograph?!
strings.notes: Gender pairs with no difference in English: #11/#12 (哥哥/姐姐), #71/#72. | RV030: omission: kept 哥哥

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}姐姐！请给我签名！
strings.en: Big Sis {VAR:0103:0}! Can I have your{NEWLINE}autograph?!

strings.zh: 什么嘛,气势完全比不上小绿馆主。
strings.en: What? Doesn’t have half the{NEWLINE}presence of Gym Leader Blue.

strings.zh: 不要老师说一句,你们就接一句！{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}冠军今天来咱们学校,{NEWLINE}是与同学们交流分享{CLEAR}作为训练家的经验心得的,{CLEAR}同学们有什么问题可以尽管请教。{CLEAR}谁想先提问？
strings.en: Stop talking back every{NEWLINE}time I say something!{SCROLL}Champion {VAR:0103:0} came to{NEWLINE}our Academy today to share what{CLEAR}they’ve learned as a Trainer. If{CLEAR}you have questions, go right ahead{CLEAR}and ask. Who wants to go first?
strings.notes: Neutral ‘they’ for the Champion (the teacher's line has no gender variant).

strings.zh: 我先来！{SCROLL}我最近看书上说{NEWLINE}柔软特性被发现了新的效果,{CLEAR}冠军大人你知道是什么效果吗？
strings.en: Me first!{SCROLL}I read in a book that they found a{NEWLINE}new effect for the Limber Ability.{CLEAR}Champion, do you know what it is?
strings.notes: Classroom Q&A #15–#55: menu answers; which answer the script counts as right isn't visible (#20/#21, #26–#28, #34–#37, #44/#45, #51–#54 are the replies).

strings.zh: 抵御更多异常状态
strings.en: Blocks more status conditions

strings.zh: 增加闪避
strings.en: Raises evasiveness

strings.zh: 增加命中
strings.en: Raises accuracy

strings.zh: 降低物理伤害
strings.en: Reduces physical damage

strings.zh: 冠军大人你说的真的对吗？{NEWLINE}我记得好像是降低物理伤害来着……
strings.en: Champion, are you sure that’s right? I{NEWLINE}thought it reduced physical damage...

strings.zh: 对对对！书上好像也是这么说的！{NEWLINE}冠军您大人知道的真多！
strings.en: Yes, yes! That’s what the book said{NEWLINE}too! You know so much, Champion!

strings.zh: 那个……冠军大人,{NEWLINE}我听说伊布有一个仙子精灵的形态。{CLEAR}可是怎么让伊布变成仙子精灵呢？
strings.en: Um... Champion, I heard Eevee has{NEWLINE}a Sylveon form. But how do you{CLEAR}make Eevee turn into Sylveon?

strings.zh: 对伊布使用觉醒石
strings.en: Use a Dawn Stone on Eevee

strings.zh: 培养与伊布之间的亲密度
strings.en: Raise Eevee’s friendship

strings.zh: 让伊布学会妖精系技能
strings.en: Teach Eevee a Fairy-type move

strings.zh: 伊布能变成仙子精灵？我怎么不知道
strings.en: Eevee can? I had no idea!

strings.zh: 连伊布能变成仙子精灵您都不知道？{NEWLINE}您虽然身为冠军,{CLEAR}但见识好像很一般嘛。
strings.en: You didn’t even know Eevee can become{NEWLINE}Sylveon? You may be the Champion,{CLEAR}but you don’t seem to know much.

strings.zh: 哎？原来是用这种方法吗？{NEWLINE}好神奇啊！
strings.en: Huh? So that’s how you{NEWLINE}do it? That’s so cool!

strings.zh: 我有问题要问！{SCROLL}听说你当年在石英大会上{NEWLINE}用作弊的手段通过了淘汰赛第一轮,{CLEAR}有这样的事吗？
strings.en: I have a question!{SCROLL}I heard you cheated your way{NEWLINE}through the first knockout round at{CLEAR}the Indigo Conference. Is that true?

strings.zh: 确实如此,我通过作弊一路赢到底
strings.en: Yep, I cheated all the way

strings.zh: 我凭本事赢下了全部比赛
strings.en: I won every match on merit
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'I won every match fair and square'

strings.zh: 你问这种问题太没礼貌了
strings.en: That’s a very rude question

strings.zh: 反正赢小绿完全不需要作弊
strings.en: No need to cheat to beat Blue
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'I don’t need to cheat to beat Blue'

strings.zh: 卑鄙小人！你这样的人能成为冠军{NEWLINE}简直就是对全地区训练家的污辱！
strings.en: You lowlife! Someone like you{NEWLINE}being Champion is an insult to{CLEAR}every Trainer in the region!

strings.zh: 吹牛,我看你根本就没那个本事！
strings.en: Liar! I bet you couldn’t do it at all!

strings.zh: 哈哈,被我说到痛处心虚了吧！
strings.en: Ha ha, I hit a sore spot,{NEWLINE}didn’t I? You’re feeling guilty!

strings.zh: 你、你、你……太气人了！
strings.en: You, you, you... That makes me so mad!

strings.zh: 住嘴吧！不准再没事找事了！{SCROLL}其他同学还有要向冠军大人请教的吗？
strings.en: Shut your mouth!{NEWLINE}No more stirring up trouble!{SCROLL}Does anyone else have a{NEWLINE}question for the Champion?
strings.notes: tone review: 住嘴吧 is a blunt 'shut your mouth'; kept (D-0627)

strings.zh: 冠军大人,您对战过的对手中,{NEWLINE}谁是最难对付的呢？
strings.en: Champion, of all the opponents you’ve{NEWLINE}battled, who was the toughest?

strings.zh: 劲敌小绿
strings.en: My rival, Blue

strings.zh: 火箭队首领坂木
strings.en: Rocket Boss Giovanni

strings.zh: 四天王渡
strings.en: Lance of the Elite Four

strings.zh: 都很一般,比我都差远了
strings.en: They were all way weaker than me

strings.zh: 哇！冠军大人您俯视天下的样子真帅！
strings.en: Wow! You look so cool, looking down on{NEWLINE}the whole world like that, Champion!

strings.zh: 哎？还有让您觉得难以对付的人吗？
strings.en: Huh? There are people{NEWLINE}even you think are tough?

strings.zh: 冠军大人,您能不能给我们推荐一些{NEWLINE}适合新手用的精灵啊？
strings.en: Champion, could you recommend some{NEWLINE}Pokémon that are good for beginners?

strings.zh: 御三家系列
strings.en: The first partner Pokémon

strings.zh: 进化快的虫系
strings.en: Fast-evolving Bug types

strings.zh: 速攻型精灵
strings.en: Fast, hard-hitting Pokémon

strings.zh: 生存力强的盾牌型精灵
strings.en: Tough, defensive Pokémon

strings.zh: 御三家是挺好啦,{NEWLINE}可是那么稀有的精灵,很难弄到的……
strings.en: The first partner Pokémon are{NEWLINE}nice, but they’re so rare.{CLEAR}They’re really hard to get...

strings.zh: 我辛辛苦苦把虫系养大,{NEWLINE}结果后期就派不上用场了,{CLEAR}这岂不是在浪费时间吗？
strings.en: If I work so hard to raise Bug types,{NEWLINE}and then they’re useless later on,{CLEAR}isn’t that just a waste of time?

strings.zh: 盾牌型精灵战斗起来好慢的……
strings.en: Defensive Pokémon take{NEWLINE}forever to win a battle...

strings.zh: 嗯！嗯！出手比别人更快！{NEWLINE}打击比别人更狠！{CLEAR}这样爽快打法的精灵{CLEAR}果然才是正确的选择！
strings.en: Yeah! Yeah! Move faster than{NEWLINE}everyone else! Hit harder than{CLEAR}everyone else! Pokémon that battle{CLEAR}like that are the right choice!

strings.zh: 冠军大人,{NEWLINE}我最讨厌问什么无聊的问题了,{CLEAR}你跟我来一场战斗吧,{CLEAR}这比解答什么问题都实在！
strings.en: Champion, I hate boring questions most{NEWLINE}of all. Battle me instead! That’s way{CLEAR}more useful than answering questions!

strings.zh: 不愧是冠军,真的好厉害……
strings.en: That’s the Champion{NEWLINE}for you. So strong...

strings.zh: 看来同学们通过与冠军大人交流,{NEWLINE}收获都很大啊！{CLEAR}那么就让我们用热烈的掌声,{CLEAR}一起感谢冠军大人吧。
strings.en: It looks like everyone learned a{NEWLINE}lot from talking with the Champion!{CLEAR}Now let’s all thank the Champion{CLEAR}with a big round of applause.

strings.zh: 谢谢——
strings.en: Thank you-!

strings.zh: 谢谢您与孩子们互动。{NEWLINE}真是给您添麻烦了。{CLEAR}这个送给你作为谢礼。
strings.en: Thank you for spending time with{NEWLINE}the children. I’m sorry for all the{CLEAR}trouble. Please take this as thanks.

strings.zh: 欢迎您以后常来我们学校坐坐。
strings.en: Please drop by our{NEWLINE}Academy again anytime.

strings.zh: 跟您近距离接触过之后,{NEWLINE}孩子们学习起来更用功了呢。
strings.en: After seeing you up close, the{NEWLINE}children are studying even harder.

strings.zh: 我的初始精灵要好好挑选,{NEWLINE}因为它可能是陪伴我最久、{CLEAR}最有感情的精灵呢。
strings.en: I have to choose my first{NEWLINE}Pokémon carefully. It might end{CLEAR}up being the one that stays with{CLEAR}me longest, the one I love most.

strings.zh: 我也想要火球鼠作为初始精灵,{NEWLINE}可是那么稀有的精灵去哪里弄啊……
strings.en: I want a Cyndaquil as my first{NEWLINE}Pokémon too, but where do you{CLEAR}even get such a rare Pokémon...

strings.zh: 俗话说读万卷书不如行万里路,{NEWLINE}等我从精灵学校毕业了,{CLEAR}我就去城都各地旅行,{CLEAR}收集道馆徽章！
strings.en: Like they say, traveling ten thousand{NEWLINE}miles beats reading ten thousand books.{CLEAR}Once I graduate from the Pokémon{CLEAR}Academy, I’m going to travel all over{CLEAR}Johto and collect Gym Badges!
strings.notes: RV030: meaning: 万里 is ten thousand miles (D-1700)

strings.zh: 您成为冠军之前,{NEWLINE}一定也在关东各地旅行过吧？{CLEAR}真是让人羡慕的训练家生活啊。
strings.en: You must have traveled all over{NEWLINE}Kanto before you became Champion,{CLEAR}right? What an enviable Trainer life.

strings.zh: 我们精灵学校有很多学生,{NEWLINE}但是毕业后能成为精英训练家的人{CLEAR}少之又少……
strings.en: Our Pokémon Academy has lots of{NEWLINE}students, but very few of them become{CLEAR}Ace Trainers after graduating...

strings.zh: 对我来说成不成为{NEWLINE}精英训练家不重要啦,{CLEAR}能与精灵一起快乐地生活{CLEAR}我就心满意足了。
strings.en: Being an Ace Trainer doesn’t{NEWLINE}matter to me. I’m happy as long as{CLEAR}I can live happily with my Pokémon.

strings.zh: 我要成为向常磐市馆主小绿那样{NEWLINE}气质与实力并存的训练家。
strings.en: I want to be a Trainer like Blue,{NEWLINE}the Viridian City Gym Leader.{CLEAR}He’s got style and strength!

strings.zh: 你是冠军又怎么样,{NEWLINE}在我心中还是小绿馆主比较强。
strings.en: So what if you’re the{NEWLINE}Champion? In my heart, Gym{CLEAR}Leader Blue is still stronger.

strings.zh: 精灵学校是系统性学习{NEWLINE}口袋妖怪知识的地方,{CLEAR}只有在这里打好了基础,{CLEAR}才能成为精英训练家。
strings.en: The Pokémon Academy is where you{NEWLINE}study Pokémon systematically. Only{CLEAR}by building a solid foundation here{CLEAR}can you become an Ace Trainer.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}哥哥！{NEWLINE}人家是你的忠实粉丝哦,{CLEAR}人家就是因为把你当成偶像,{CLEAR}才会来精灵学校学习的哦。
strings.en: Big Bro {VAR:0103:0}! I’m your biggest fan!{NEWLINE}You’re my idol, and that’s why I came to{CLEAR}study at the Pokémon Academy!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}姐姐！{NEWLINE}人家是你的忠实粉丝哦,{CLEAR}人家就是因为把你当成偶像,{CLEAR}才会来精灵学校学习的哦。
strings.en: Big Sis {VAR:0103:0}! I’m your biggest fan!{NEWLINE}You’re my idol, and that’s why I came to{CLEAR}study at the Pokémon Academy!

strings.zh: 知道我这里是什么位置吗？
strings.en: Do you know what spot this is?

strings.zh: 真是没上过学的土老帽,{NEWLINE}我这里是上课睡觉的最佳位置。
strings.en: What a clueless bumpkin. You’ve{NEWLINE}obviously never been to school. This{CLEAR}is the best seat in class for sleeping.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,我实在是不愿意学习,{NEWLINE}所以老师就把我安排到这里来了。
strings.en: Heh heh, I really don’t want to{NEWLINE}study, so the teacher put me here.

strings.zh: 看到你这位冠军之后,{NEWLINE}我突然就觉得{CLEAR}能成为你这样的人应该也不错。{CLEAR}看来今后需要好好学点东西了。
strings.en: Seeing you, the Champion,{NEWLINE}I suddenly feel like being someone{CLEAR}like you would be pretty cool. Guess{CLEAR}I’d better start studying for real.
